tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm cream in light, deep night in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, pricing tiers, form fields and the secondary button fill.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Alternating section bands and soft highlight panels behind a feature.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on surface, surface-raised and surface-tint (15:1+ in both themes). Also control borders.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, captions and meta text on surface, surface-raised and surface-tint (6:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and quiet card outlines only; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Sunrise Orange, the identity colour. Primary button fill, hero blocks, the active Founder Trajectory stage. Put on-brand text on it; never use it as text on light surfaces.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Orange when it must be text: eyebrows, inline highlights, numbers on surface (4.8:1 light, 6.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand fills (5.7:1 light, 6.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Savanna Gold. Second identity colour: badges, highlight blocks, the Growth tier, celebratory moments.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on gold fills (11:1+).

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Corridor Teal. Growth, progress and success: progress bars, completed steps, the Elevate tier.

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on teal fills (5.2:1 light, 8.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: teal-text
tokens.usage: Links and success text on surface (5.0:1 light, 8.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Deep feature bands (the RENZOLO OS showcase, footer). Put cream text on it via the dark theme or ink from the dark theme.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 3px focus ring, 2px offset, on every interactive element. 3:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: tick-up
tokens.usage: Live score rising: the change figure and arrow on surface and surface-raised (5.2:1 light, 7.4:1 dark). Always paired with a plus sign and an up arrow.

tokens.name: tick-down
tokens.usage: Live score falling: the change figure and arrow on surface and surface-raised (5.1:1 light, 5.7:1 dark). Always paired with a minus sign and a down arrow.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Futuristic layer: translucent panel fill, with backdrop-filter blur(16px). Falls back to surface-raised where blur is unsupported.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Futuristic layer: 1px edge on glass panels and the faint dot grid on dark bands. Decorative only.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Ready for customers, capital and investors.
styles.usage: Home hero headline only. Drop to display-lg under 720px wide.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section headlines and the mobile hero.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card titles at feature size, pricing tier names.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Know exactly where your business stands, and what to fix first.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your assessment, plan and dashboard in one place.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a section headline, set in brand-text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Fine print, chart labels, form hints, in ink-muted.

styles.name: ticker
styles.usage: The live Readiness Score headline number. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Changes, sub-scores, timestamps and table figures. Tabular numerals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter, default stack gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop card padding, grid gaps.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between a headline block and its content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Mobile section padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Desktop section padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small chips' inner elements, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Feature cards, image frames, stage tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Hero panels, pricing cards, large colour blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, stage chips, badges.

shadow.note: RENZOLO uses a playful offset shadow on interactive things and a soft lift on floating things. Nothing else casts a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Resting state of primary and secondary buttons and clickable feature cards.

tokens.name: shadow-pop-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state, paired with translateY(-2px).

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Floating dashboard screenshots, menus and the sticky header on scroll.

tokens.name: glow-brand
tokens.usage: Futuristic layer: the single glowing element per screen (the live score card or the primary button on a dark band).
